scope: opt-in candidate enrollment proof and native reference publication journal
enrollment: Exact independent request/challenge/proof bytes and signatures
Standard and X-Wing HPKE ciphertexts open to the expected independent proof
Both decryption results and device signature required
Explicit fingerprint, authority, device, current roster and expiry checks
Mixed ceremony, altered ciphertext, expired/future request, replay and stale roster rejected
Single-use pending approval prepares a candidate without advancing the pin
journal: Atomic signed history and retry record publication
Reopen and historical exact retry after a later commit
Stale CAS, conflicting operation-ID reuse and receipt mismatch rejected
Exclusive locking and restrictive Unix file mode
Failure injection after temporary write, file sync, replacement and directory sync
Retained newer pin rejects coherent old-journal rollback
limits: No account/session authorization, collection access, device package or migration integration
No physical power-loss or disk-full certification
No global freshness proof after loss of all newer independent evidence
Unsigned receipt correspondence is not independent proof of remote publication
128 publications and 8 MiB journal cap; no silent compaction
